professional_summary: Senior Data Engineer with 5+ years of hands-on experience designing, building, and operating the data infrastructure that powers enterprise analytics at scale. At Austal USA - a $2B+ Navy shipbuilding program - I've architected containerized ETL systems processing 2M+ records daily from 20+ heterogeneous sources, engineered sub-2-second data pipelines from what were previously 10-minute manual processes, and built the governance and lineage infrastructure that passed ISO 9001 audits and enabled real-time operational intelligence. I work across the full data engineering stack: pipeline design, distributed processing, database optimization, containerized deployment, and IoT sensor integration. I don't just build pipelines - I build pipelines that stay reliable, stay fast, and stay compliant as data volumes and source diversity grow.
